blocks.text: The gateway is the only code that talks to the application service, and its types encode the privacy rules: a draft cannot carry a sensitive field, and telemetry has no slot for a value.

blocks.title: Card application API semantics
rows: Replace the history entry with the status route
The same key after a completed request
Same route; no second application exists
The same key while the first request is still running
Wait, then retry with the same key, which returns the first application once it settles
The same key with different fields
Treat as a client bug: keep the fields and start a new attempt
Map errors by field name, focus the error summary, end the attempt
Poll while pending review; stop on a final status

blocks.title: Accessible fields and error recovery
blocks.text: Every field has a visible label and the matching autocomplete token, such as given-name, street-address or postal-code. Errors are tied to their fields with aria-describedby and listed in a summary at the top of the section, and a failed submit moves focus to that summary. Submit progress and the decision are announced in a polite live region, and a session timeout warns before it expires and offers more time.
